Site.name: GameCollabs
Site.description: Track game collaborations and crossover events: which anime, films, characters and brands teamed up with which games, when, and how. Hand-reviewed from public sources.
Site.mockBanner: Development mode: showing mock data. Set API_BASE_URL to use the real API.
Site.disclaimer: This website is not affiliated with or endorsed by any of the companies or games featured on it. All images and intellectual property belong to their respective copyright holders.

empty.upcoming: No upcoming collabs with a start date.
empty.ending: No ongoing collabs with an announced end date.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.body: The address may have changed, or the entry is not published yet.

Report.dialogDescription: Tell us what is wrong or missing on “{title}”. We check the sources before fixing it.
Report.pageDescription: Know a game × IP collab we haven’t listed yet? Send us the link and we’ll add it once we’ve checked the public sources.

urlHint.tip: An official announcement, news article or official social post that confirms the collab
urlHint.correction: An official announcement or article that shows the correct information

noteHint.tip: Anything the link doesn’t make clear, such as the game, IP or dates (up to 1000 characters)
noteHint.correction: Tell us which detail is wrong and what it should be (5–1000 characters)

notePlaceholder.tip: e.g. Korea server only, starts late October
notePlaceholder.correction: e.g. The end date was announced as October 31.

Report.privacy: We don’t ask for your name or contact details. To prevent abuse we only keep a hash of your IP address.

sent.tip: Thanks! We’ll check the sources and add it.
sent.correction: Thanks! We’ll check it and fix the page.

fieldError.invalid_url: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://.
fieldError.too_short: Please add a bit more detail (5+ characters).

error.rate_limited: Too many reports. Please try again in an hour.
error.bot_check: The bot check failed. Please try again.
error.not_found: We couldn’t find this collab. Please reload the page.
error.unknown: We couldn’t send your report. Please try again shortly.

Stats.lead: {count, plural, one {# game × IP collab} other {# game × IP collabs}} in the tracker, counted by period, category and the games and IPs involved.
Stats.yearLead: {count, plural, one {# game × IP collab} other {# game × IP collabs}} that started in {year}, counted by month, category and the games and IPs involved.
Stats.metaDescription: Statistics on {count, plural, one {# game × IP collab} other {# game × IP collabs}}: monthly and yearly trends, partner categories such as anime, webtoons and brands, and the games, IPs and companies with the most collabs.
Stats.yearMetaDescription: {count, plural, one {# game collab} other {# game collabs}} that started in {year}: monthly trend, partner categories, and the games, IPs and companies with the most collabs.

chart.undated: {count, plural, one {# collab has} other {# collabs have}} no announced start date yet and {count, plural, one {is} other {are}} left out of the monthly and yearly counts.
chart.share: {percent}% of {count, plural, one {# collab} other {# collabs}}

role.licensor: IP holders with the most collabs

method.collectionStart: We started collecting in April 2026. Collabs that started before then are only partly covered.
method.published: Only collabs we have reviewed and published are counted.
method.start: The monthly trend uses each collab's start date. A year's statistics count only collabs that started that year.
method.multi: A collab can fall under several categories, regions or platforms, so shares can add up to more than 100%. Several partners of the same category count once for that category.
method.coverage: These figures describe the collabs in this tracker, not the whole industry.
method.yearLinks: Category links list every collab running that year, so the list can show more than the count here.
